decision.observation: 13 mph, gear 1, timer 25:58.901, all dots pale, no red X. The car has run off the gravel onto the grass strip right of the road, sitting between white marker posts; the road sweeps left and down-frame, curving away from the car.
decision.hypothesis: The gentle right-hand drift under plain throttle again put the car on the right verge, and with the road bending left the gap will widen. Steering at 13 mph has repeatedly zeroed or overshot, so a brief brake (0.5 s, shorter than the 1 s that flipped to reverse) should drop the speed into the 8-10 mph band where rejoins have worked.
decision.memory: Off-road drift happens even on gentle bends at 13+ mph; brake taps need shortening to ~0.5 s to avoid an R conversion, and rejoining is reliable once back under ~10 mph.
